_note: Phase 38 — the golden-chart harness. Time-INVARIANT judged meaning pinned for five reference nativities. Age-dependent fields (lord of the year, profection house) are deliberately excluded, since they drift with today's date. A change to any pinned value means the ENGINE'S INTERPRETATION drifted — investigate before accepting. Regenerate only on a deliberate doctrine change, and record why.

doctrineChanges.change: peregrine is the neutral no-dignity case, never a second charge on top of a debility
doctrineChanges.why: essentialOf9 set out.peregrine from have9.length===0 alone, so a planet in its detriment or fall was ALSO marked peregrine and Lilly's essential column charged it twice (-5 debility plus -5 peregrine). The app's own label logic already treats them as alternatives (a detriment planet is labelled Detriment, never Peregrine) and its own gloss calls peregrine 'neither helped nor harmed by its sign', which cannot be true of a planet in its fall. Lilly's debilities are alternatives on one table, not cumulative.
doctrineChanges.effect: Only planets in detriment or fall change, each by exactly +5 essential. Across the five reference nativities exactly one judged verdict moved: B.h10 withheld -> promised, because its lord Mercury in Sagittarius (detriment) went from -10 to -5 essential, taking its Lilly total from -2 to +3 and across the >=3 threshold at which a house-lord can pay.
